_doc: e0 V1 probe battery (PROPOSAL-e §2, B1). Each probe is a held-out mundane task appended to a context as the NEXT round, completion-style: 'Task: {probe}\nResponse:' -- the marker read is the next-token distribution at the final position (the response-opener distribution). Probes are disjoint from the e0 extraction corpus, CONDITIONING_TASKS, and FLAT_PROBE_BATTERY, and are burned for V1. Token classes are CANDIDATE markers: B1 measures their natural post-praise vs post-criticism discrimination on a fit half (tasks split by id) and validates on the held-out half; only survivors enter the B2 pre-registration. Class words are resolved to token ids with leading-space and capitalization variants at runtime.
probes: Suggest a title for a short film about a lost umbrella.
Write one sentence describing the sound of a busy café.
Rewrite this more politely: Send me the file now.
Summarize in one sentence: The bakery on Elm Street now opens an hour earlier on weekdays.
Write a one-sentence caption for a photo of a cat asleep on a stack of newspapers.
Suggest a name for a community tool-lending library.
Describe the feeling of stepping into warm sunlight in one sentence.
Write a one-sentence reminder to water the office plants.
Rewrite this without cliché: We must think outside the box.
Write a one-sentence welcome for visitors to a small museum.
Suggest a subject line for an email about a lost-and-found box.
Describe an empty train platform at night in one sentence.

readout.storage: per-context sparse top-4096 next-token log-probs, floor-imputed
readout.selection: top-256 tokens per probe by |mean log-prob difference| on the fit half, union across probes
readout.validation: AUC of the fit-half mean-difference readout on the held-out task half
readout.split: tasks e01-e24 = fit half, e25-e48 = validation half (fixed by id, declared before B1 data)
